name: BUTTERFLY BRIDGE
introduce: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your knees bent and opened to the sides. \n\nSqueeze and lift your hips off the ground, and bring your knees together; then return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
It helps to stretch your hip flexors.
This is a good exercise for your pelvic floor muscles and inner thigh muscles.
It also improves your sex life.
